summary: Reverified all 33 requested estimates against the complete 11-page article and 49-page supplement. Both markdown conversions were read in full; all cited numerical PDF pages were opened with PyMuPDF, and the supplementary adjusted-analysis table was recovered with find_tables(). All 57 numerical source quotations were found on their cited pages, and all non-null statistics and counts match the printed values and the recorded outcomes and arms. No numerical transcription corrections were identified. The 33 problems are unresolved required question classifications: every retained estimate has question=null, outside the codebook vocabulary. AI availability during advice writing is not established, so no replacement question or outcome_with_ai value is guessed. The script warnings about text_features are false positives under the current codebook section 6, which explicitly permits that measure for automatically tagged word-type counts; spaCy named-entity counts fit it. The supplementary quotation warnings are also false positives: the S5 quotations and 812-person links-arm count appear in pgaf316_supplementary_data.pdf p. 5, and S6 outcome quotations appear on p. 7. Unprinted arm counts and uncertainty remain null. S5 omnibus tests are correctly kept out of the pairwise test fields, while its two printed cosine t tests retain their original negative signs. S6 outcome-specific counts remain unconfirmed because the printed final sample, exclusions, and degrees of freedom conflict. The S3 choice percentages and interval match the printed labels; the paper itself contradicts those labels in its prose, as the extraction already notes, and the three-category chi-square test is explicitly identified as such. The remaining construct, measure, unit, direction, timing, within-person, comparison-type, and uncertainty codes are supported or appropriately left unresolved. Recipient uncertainty is not mistaken for writer-level uncertainty. No additional clearly eligible outcome or contrast was found: process measures, self-reports, intentions, mediation, and post-treatment-adjusted results are excluded, and the mattress-advice recipient replication does not establish an eligible randomized source-writer sample.
